The deliverable correctly calculates the working capital shortfall as $350,000 ($2,000,000 - $1,650,000), derives an adjusted Purchase Price of $159,650,000, and identifies the $350,000 discrepancy with the Seller's draft figure of $159,300,000.

The deliverable correctly calculates the long-stop date as 8 November 2026 (150 days after 11 June 2026), identifies that expected regulatory clearance on 8 December 2026 falls after this date, and recommends an extension.
The deliverable provides the escrow release period as 18 months, the date as 11 March 2028, and correctly calculates 617 days remaining from the deliverable date of 3 July 2026.
The deliverable correctly notes that 11 March 2028 falls on a Saturday and that the release date adjusts to the next business day, 13 March 2028 (Monday).
